conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 3. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 182 | 750 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 122 | 750 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
